sources.title: Electric vehicles & charge points
sources.verified_claim: TfL's EV page links the 2025 update to London's EV infrastructure strategy, with updated charging forecasts and commitments on affordability, accessibility and delivery barriers. London-wide forecasts are not evidence of a connection or charger at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Electric vehicle charging
sources.verified_claim: Enfield describes a rolling public-highway and car-park charging programme targeted toward areas of need, with annual delivery dependent on funding. A rolling borough programme does not guarantee a charger near parcel_30762.

sources.title: Enfield boosts electric vehicle charging opportunities
sources.verified_claim: Enfield announced installation of 1,000 new on-street charge points plus standalone replacements, with an ambition for shared access within a five-minute walk. Programme scale and ambition are not exact parcel service evidence.

sources.title: Council housing parking strategy
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's council-housing parking strategy covers TMOs, cycle storage, EV charging and emergency access on housing land. Estate-management rules apply only where relevant and do not determine planning capacity of the sample parcel.

sources.title: Where We Live: All plugged in for EV charging points
sources.verified_claim: Havering reported government-backed rollout of public charging in council car parks and residential streets, including 61 car-park points and 48 residential-street points in the described phase. Borough rollout is not exact proximity or capacity evidence for parcel_46142.

sources.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Point Consultation
sources.verified_claim: Havering's closed consultation records location preferences and subsequent funding/delivery intentions. Historical consultation evidence is retained as aged context and not treated as current charger inventory.

sources.title: Lambeth set out bold Electric Vehicle Strategy to 2030
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's EV Strategy supports charging expansion for journeys that cannot shift to walking, cycling or public transport while also calling for lower overall motor-vehicle travel. Strategy direction does not prove sample-parcel charger capacity.

sources.title: Installing a charge point at home
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains that some off-street charge points can be permitted development, while others require planning permission or lawful-development confirmation, and that requested nearby public chargers are not guaranteed. Exact planning status depends on site facts.
